mapper.select: SELECT TENANT_ID, USER_ID, KIND, STATUS, LEASE_OWNER_ID, LEASE_EPOCH, LEASE_EXPIRES_AT FROM ASYNC_TASK WHERE TASK_ID=#{id} AND DELETED=0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT REVISION, STATE_JSON FROM ASYNC_TASK_DAG_CHECKPOINT WHERE TASK_ID=#{id} AND DELETED=0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ASYNC_TASK_DAG_CHECKPOINT (TASK_ID, REVISION, STATE_JSON, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{id},1,#{json},#{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE ASYNC_TASK_DAG_CHECKPOINT SET REVISION=REVISION+1, STATE_JSON=#{json}, UPDATED_AT=#{now} WHERE TASK_ID=#{id} AND REVISION=#{revision} AND DELETED=0
